title: Current-location (World Maps linked lore) activation route and its reserve budget unexplained
skill_evidence: references/lorebooks.md:313 'or an attached map location' and :254 'constants rejected by a location budget likewise stay out of later scans (#5943)' are the only mentions; Token Budget Management (lorebooks.md:236) lists only the lorebook tokenBudget and the chat-wide Lorebook Token Budget
reality: Entries linked to a World Maps location (location Details -> Linked lore) activate without a keyword while that exact location is current, still subject to disabled/chat-excluded state, conditions, timing, probability and budgets; links don't inherit parent->child (engine docs/agents/hierarchical-maps.md:624-646). They first pass a separate current-location reserve of 2,048 tokens (packages/server/src/services/lorebook/index.ts:693 CURRENT_LOCATION_LORE_TOKEN_BUDGET, applied at :1581) and then the ordinary budgets. Entries declined by that reserve can still activate through keywords, sticky or recursion within the ordinary lore budget, but declined constants cannot bypass it (CHANGELOG-v2.5.0.md:916 v2.4.6 #6143; :1165 #5943; index.ts:1586-1589). Diagnostics report such skips as blocked by location.
fix: lorebooks.md Token Budget Management: add a short paragraph 'Current-location lore (World Maps package)': link entries to a map location via Linked lore; they activate keyword-free while the party is at that exact location (no parent inheritance), go through a 2,048-token current-location reserve before the normal lorebook/chat budgets, declined non-constants can still fire via keywords/sticky/recursion (v2.4.6, #6143), declined constants cannot (#5943). Point to docs/agents/hierarchical-maps.md -> Link lore to locations, and make the Decision 'attached map location' mention and the recursion '#5943' sentence refer to it.

title: Activation-question threshold is seeded from the selected Decision model and does not follow a model switch
skill_evidence: references/conditional-prompts.md:56-59 'Probabilities aren't comparable across models... Only an agent's threshold can be changed. Run when probability is at least (0.05-0.95) is the only override'; :174 'activationThreshold (0.05-0.95)' - nothing on how the agent's value is initialised or that it goes stale
reality: CHANGELOG-v2.5.0.md:569: activation-question thresholds start from what the selected decision model actually answers around (a general local model scores a clear scene change ~0.99, a purpose-built decision model ~0.2, so one fixed number made the second kind skip every relevant turn while appearing to work); 'The editor seeds new questions from the selected model and offers to put its recommended value back.' docs/agents/custom-agents.md:149: the editor recommends 0.5 for local chat models and Decision connections or the sidecar manifest value (0.1 for built-in Open-Jev); 'Check the threshold against your own chats, especially after switching models.' A saved threshold is not retuned when the Decision model changes.
fix: conditional-prompts.md Thresholds bullets (and the Activation question bullet at :173-177): add 'A new activation question's threshold is seeded from the currently selected Decision model's recommended value (0.5 local/connections, 0.1 managed Open-Jev); the editor offers to restore it. Saved thresholds do not follow a later model switch - after switching (e.g. local model -> sidecar) re-check or restore each agent's threshold, or the agent can silently skip every turn.'

title: Agent-lore provenance narrowed to Keeper; trash restore of lore changes missing
skill_evidence: references/lorebooks.md:384 'Provenance (v2.5.0): Keeper entries remember their source messages (sourceMessageRefs). Deleting a message (single or bulk) removes entries whose whole source turn is gone and undoes in-place rewrites that turn made...'
reality: Provenance is stamped on every lorebook_update agent write, not only Lorebook Keeper: packages/server/src/routes/generate.routes.ts:5904-5921 (getLorebookSourceMessageRefs for any agent; Keeper only gets a special processed-message ref) and retry-agents-route.ts:5344 (custom read-behind agents); CHANGELOG-v2.5.0.md:809 'cleans up lore that agents extracted from the deleted turns'. With message Trash on (Recover deleted chat messages, Settings -> Advanced -> Features), 'Restoring a trashed message brings back the lorebook changes an agent made with it' (CHANGELOG-v2.5.0.md:30, #7146).
fix: lorebooks.md:384: change 'Keeper entries remember' to 'Entries written by Lorebook Keeper and other lorebook_update agents remember', and append 'Restoring a trashed message (Recover deleted chat messages on) brings back the lore changes an agent made with it (v2.5.0, #7146).'

title: Markdown/CSV entry import size and count limits not stated
skill_evidence: references/lorebooks.md:399 '(v2.5.0, #6698) Entries can also be imported from and exported to Markdown ... or CSV ... a failed import changes nothing.' - no limits
reality: CHANGELOG-v2.5.0.md:339 'text imports enforce bounded size and entry counts'. packages/shared/src/utils/lorebook-text-format.ts:24-25: LOREBOOK_TEXT_MAX_CHARS = 1024*1024 (about 1M characters of text) and LOREBOOK_TEXT_MAX_ENTRIES = 20,000; over-limit text is rejected (:225, :243, :377).
fix: lorebooks.md Migration from SillyTavern, Markdown/CSV sentence: add 'one import takes up to about 1M characters and 20,000 entries - split larger spreadsheets'.

title: Strands decider version tag implies a released pre-2.5.0 decision feature
skill_evidence: references/conditional-prompts.md:114 'Servers that need a description for every option (Strands decider) refused choices before v2.5.0 (#6981).'
reality: Decision statements, decision_choice and Decision connections were introduced in v2.5.0 itself (CHANGELOG-v2.5.0.md:536 #6569, :580 #6530), and the Strands fix #6981 (CHANGELOG-v2.5.0.md:156) is in the same 2.5.0 section, so no released version ever refused these choices; at v2.5.0 Strands decider answers decision_choice normally.
fix: conditional-prompts.md:114: replace with 'Servers that need a description for every option (e.g. Strands decider) are sent one, so decision_choice works with them (#6981).' - drop 'before v2.5.0'.
